emails.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
emails.body:
Dear WÃ¤lzlager-Zentrum SÃ¼d GmbH team,

Thank you for your offer and for sharing the cost indicators behind it. Please send your cost calculation in XLSX format so we can review the individual elements together. We would be open to discussing a longer-term agreement linked to volume commitments, alongside the corresponding pricing and payment terms.

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Producer prices DE: bearings, gears, gearing and driving elements changed +0.6% from 2026-02 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2815@2026-02, idx:PPI-C2815@2026-08). Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed +1.7% from 2025-12 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-12, idx:LCI-C@2026-06). Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 4.79, payment_days 14, contract_months 36; unit_price 4.84, payment_days 60, contract_months 36; unit_price 4.81, payment_days 30, contract_months 36). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
